data.name: Vishal
data.gender_notes: Vishal is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit viśāla, 'huge, broad, great'. Its root is Sanskrit viśāla (विशाल). A classical Sanskrit term for greatness. Vishal is a Sanskrit name meaning “Huge; broad; great”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vishal expresses “Huge; broad; great”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit viśāla, 'huge, broad, great'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishal total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

vedic_reference.note: Vishal is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'vis' meaning 'to spread'. In Hindu mythology, Vishal is a synonym for Vishnu and also refers to the expansive, all-pervading aspect of the universe.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for greatness.
